jailbreakbench.note:
NOT AVAILABLE -- jailbreakbench not installed.
  Install: pip install jailbreakbench
  What would be measured:
    - JBB provides 100 standard jailbreak behaviors with 10 attack methods each
    - CipherGuard would be run on each behavior prompt (surface=direct, cat=Jailbreak)
    - Metrics: detection rate (recall), false positive rate on benign behaviors
    - Comparison: CipherGuard vs JBB's built-in judge scoring
    - Respects JBB's eval-only split (no training overlap)

wildguardtest.note:
NOT AVAILABLE -- wildguard package not installed.
  Install: pip install wildguard  (or follow repo README: allenai/wildguard)
  What would be measured:
    - WildGuardTest has 1725 test prompts (harmful/benign/refusal)
    - CipherGuard would be evaluated on the harmful vs benign split
    - Metrics: precision, recall, F1 on multi-category labels
    - Key comparison: WildGuard model accuracy vs CipherGuard on same inputs

harmbench.note:
NOT AVAILABLE -- HuggingFace datasets not installed.
  Install: pip install datasets
  Dataset: walledai/HarmBench on HuggingFace Hub
  What would be measured:
    - HarmBench provides 400 harmful behaviors across 7 functional categories
    - CipherGuard would be run on the standard_behaviors test split
    - Metrics: Attack Success Rate detected (recall), per-category breakdown
    - Note: HarmBench evaluates attack success, not just prompt risk;
      CipherGuard evaluates prompt risk at gateway -- complementary, not identical

injecagent.note:
NOT AVAILABLE -- HuggingFace datasets not installed.
  Install: pip install datasets
  Dataset: abcdabcd987/InjecAgent on HuggingFace Hub (or local clone)
  What would be measured:
    - InjecAgent provides 1054 test cases for indirect injection in agent tasks
    - Content is injected into tool outputs (web search, email, calendar, etc.)
    - CipherGuard would run on the injected_prompt field with surface=indirect
    - Category: Prompt Injection (task-hijacking)
    - This is the most relevant external benchmark for CipherGuard's indirect surface
    - Metrics: detection rate, FP rate on non-injected tool outputs
    - PRIORITY: install this benchmark first for indirect injection validation

agentdojo.note:
NOT AVAILABLE -- agentdojo not installed.
  Install: pip install agentdojo
  What would be measured:
    - AgentDojo provides 97 injection tasks across 5 agent environments
    - It measures end-to-end attack success vs task utility
    - CipherGuard would be inserted as a gateway before tool-output processing
    - Requires running a full agent loop -- not just prompt classification
    - Integration complexity: HIGH (not a drop-in classifier benchmark)
    - Suitable for future integration testing, not Phase 3 evaluation
